## Spec and scope

Link features/<feature>/spec.md or the security milestone spec. Identify completed criteria, exclusions and remaining manual checks. Do not publish private notes or detailed unrelated unpatched findings merely to include every local evidence link.

## Verification

- [ ] Locked dependency installation is current (npm ci when required).
- [ ] npm run check: record the actual result, including failed/blocked stages.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral regressions verify the intended behavior.
- [ ] Required browser/TV/VM checkpoint: actual result and scope, or explicitly not performed.

## Delivery and privacy

- [ ] Reviewed explicit changed files; no real tokens, private URLs, provider/session data, media, credential screenshots, private VM notes or transfer archives.
- [ ] Reviewed Git author AND committer identity before publication.
- [ ] Preserved token/state compatibility and relevant range/restart behavior, or documented an intentional change.
- [ ] Preserved required provenance record and matching credit, or explicitly recorded blocked submission.

Include generated translation assets when applicable. State whether deployment actually happened; code review and deployment results are distinct.
